decision.description: blocked or needs_changes prevents readiness; ready means the bounded approved task is verified; resumed means its plan is resumed, never shipped.

coverage.description: Current PASSING test evidence for every method required by the assigned task. Complete requires all to pass; incomplete includes missing, failed or stale results; not_run means no current tests were run or required.

review_state.description: Validity of the SUPPLIED review certificate. Use not_supplied when no certificate is supplied, even when you inspect or review the work yourself.
